spans.s: 1. जठर mf(आ)n. (v.l. for बठ्˚, q.v.) hard, firm, Śāntiś. iv, 13 & Sāh. (v.l. जरठ);
for जरठ, old, Bhartṛ. iii, 92
= बद्ध, L.
for जवन, R. ii, 98, 24
अति-, ‘very hard’ and ‘very old’, Śiś. iv, 29
N. of a man, Pravar. iv (Mādh.)
of a mountain, BhP. v, 16, 28
pl. N. of a people (in the south-east of Madhya-deśa, VarBṛS. xiv, 8), MBh. vi, 350.
2. जठ॑र n. [m.] the stomach, belly, abdomen, bowels, womb, interior of anything, cavity, RV.; AV. &c.
certain morbid affections of the bowels, Car. vi, 1; Suśr. i, vi
जठर, [cf. γαστήρ ?; Goth. kilthei or qvithrs].
mf(ई)n. being on or in or relating to the stomach or belly or womb (जठ॑र), MBh. xii, 9661; MārkP. ii, 37
with अग्नि, ‘stomach fire’, digestive faculty, MBh. iii, 149; Suśr.
hunger, Pañcat. ii, 6, 50 (iv, 8, 3); BhP. iv
‘womb-offspring’, a child, iii, 14, 38
N. of one of Skanda's attendants, MBh. ix, 2564.
जठर—त्व n., ‘hardness’, only अ- neg., tenderness, Vām. iii, 1, 19.
(एण), instr. ind. (opposed to पृष्ठ-तस्) so as to turn the face towards, Hit. ii, 3, 3
जठर—गद m. a morbid affection of the abdomen or bowels (= हृद्-रोग, Sch.), VarBṛS. civ, 6 and 13.
जठर—ज्वलन n. ‘stomach-heat’, hunger, Bhām. i, 49.
जठर—ज्वाला f. belly-ache, colic, W.
जठर—नुद् m. ‘removing the Jaṭhara disease’, Cathartocarpus fistula, L.
जठर—यन्त्रणा f. pain endured (by the embryo) in the womb, W.
जठर—रोग m. = -गद, VarBṛS. civ, 16.
जठर—व्यथा f. = -ज्वाला, W.
जठर—स्थ mfn. being in the belly or in the womb, W.
जठर—स्थायिन् mfn. id., W.
जठर—स्थित mfn. id., W.
digestive stomach-fire, gastric juice, Gṛhyās. i, 11; Kathās. lxxiii, 58; Hcat.
cf. जाठर.
‘stomach-disease’, dropsy, L.
a festive dinner, L.
affected with the Jaṭhara disease, Car. v, 6, vi, 18; Suśr. iv, 18, 32.
‘contained in the belly’, concealed in the bosom, BhP. iii, 9, 20.
(= 2. जठ॑र, ‘cavity [of waters], ocean’, Sāy.), i, 182, 6.
morbid affection of the belly, Suśr.
